commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Mishra turns symmetric artifact spell-counter/tuck triggers into one-sided artifact deployment from graveyard/library. Assemble cheap artifacts, colored 1UBR commander and parity prison then win through Top/Citadel/KCI/Station or Karn-Lattice.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Bracket 5 fringe cEDH artifact stax-combo: 4-mana color-heavy commander constrains consistency despite high-priority self-counter locks and fast artifacts.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Reject Thassa Oracle/Consult/Breach packages and Scepter/Reversal swap deleting Blood Funnel; preserve specific Mishra cast-counter-trigger stack sequences.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: Reused October19 named 99-slot comprehensive M6 role ledger and challenged all seven baseline self-counters, colored mana, artifact spell loops, low-curve tutors, stack protection and KCI win roles. Six selected cut slots plus at least six independent post-floor weak slots received exact role-cost arguments in memo.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 29 lands preserved, Academy Ruins colorless replaced by untapped Otawara blue; Petal adds one-shot any-color to previously color-stranded 1UBR hands, 9-mana Gargoyle removed; Workshop remains only artifact-cast colorless, Mox Amber conditional on legend.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Swat, Fluster improve commander deployment defense but free Swat is countered by own Bauble/Mirror, both nonartifact spells may self-counter after Funnel/Chaos/Storm. Force suite and Vandalblast/Rift/Toxic remain.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Explored Grinding Station, Ice Cave, Power Artifact, Reshape, Defense Grid, Otawara alongside EDHREC high lift and prior Petal/Gargoyle candidate.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Prison-first complete 100 preserved Gargoyle but sacrificed draw Uthros. Loses repeatable triggered card access and leaves awkward nine mana.
Artifact-value complete 100 preserves Monitor but sacrifices lock copy Sculpting Steel. Direct draw upside loses Mishra-specific prison copying.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Lotus Petal reconsidered over both Nullstone Gargoyle and Uthros; Grinding Station over Thought Monitor and Sculpting Steel; Reshape versus Wishclaw or Fabricate. All compared as exact legal 100s.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: One-shot Petal is absent despite a 4-color-symbol 1UBR commander in a 29-land deck with Workshop and other colorless sources; protection needs early U/R rather than late reactive mana.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Selected six open-ended, quality-grounded swaps after full source recovery and role-cost evaluation, despite losing real Gargoyle and Monitor strengths. No simulated win percentages.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: Rechecked all 99 roles against earlier full named audit after sixth selected trade; tested the case for additional lower-curve tutors, artifact stax, protection and conditional mana without treating six as ceiling.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Grid shields own turn at two mana but taxes own interaction on opponents' turns and deletes native counter-recoup trigger.
Reshape puts artifact directly in play and can trigger Scrap Trawler from sacrificed artifact, but is UUX and counterable as nonartifact under Funnel; Wishclaw retains universal tutoring.
Same early fixing but would remove repeatable commander-stationed cast draw and leave 9MV Gargoyle.
Keep Thought Monitor as draw but lose key artifact copying/cross-package tutor role.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: MVX battlefield artifact tutoring on top of primary six can speed specific lock completion with fodder.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Wishclaw's 2-mana artifact-based universal tutor has stronger flexibility and fewer second-color/replacement costs.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Adds lower-curve artifact shielding combo turns, could be preferred at countermagic-heavy tables.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Deletes native self-counter parity and taxes own opposing-turn defensive spells, especially with less-than-ideal blue access.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: After tested whole 100 and four exact full 100 challengers, marginal additions weaken known native counter recursion, late artifact-copy/Universal tutor flexibility, or defense relative to role gains. Remaining credible dispute is Gargoyle prison versus Petal colored access; early UBR was prioritized transparently, not mathematically proven.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Exact 100/100 singleton and 29 lands, owner Oct15 source 100/100 baseline; 6 exact one-for-one swaps, six-source parity core+Storm retained, clean current 100/100 Scryfall selected identities (Oracle IDs, legal UBR) and live banned-list checkpoint.
